summary: CompactString::retain updates its length only after iteration, so a predicate panic can leave partially compacted bytes exposed at the original length, violating UTF-8 validity. The added test removes the first character of "0è0", retains 'è', then panics on the last character and checks UTF-8 validity after catching the panic. The fix uses a drop guard to set the length to the retained prefix during both normal completion and unwinding. This is a source-inspected plan; no tests were run.
